topics.question: What is NodeChart?
topics.answer: NodeChart is a browser-based charting workspace for selected CEX markets and DEX pools. It combines provider feeds with charting and analysis tools. Core access needs no account or recurring subscription; ads may appear, some themes unlock when a share composer opens, and selected Pro features require verified on-chain support.

topics.question: Do I need an account or API key?
topics.answer: No account or personal exchange API key is required. Market data comes from public providers, sometimes directly and sometimes through first-party serverless proxy routes. Providers and hosting services may process connection and request metadata.

topics.question: How do I switch between the 1×1, 2×1 and 2×2 layouts?
topics.answer: Use the layout switcher in the terminal toolbar, or press 1, 2 or 3. The selected layout is stored in this browser and can be removed by clearing browser storage.

topics.question: How do I change the symbol I am watching?
topics.answer: Open symbol search and choose an instrument. Each pane can use its own symbol; the first pane follows the active token. Pair, history and timeframe coverage depend on the selected provider.

topics.question: Which timeframes and chart types are supported?
topics.answer: Seven standard timeframes run from 1m to 1w; custom intervals depend on the selected feed. Chart types include candles, bars, line, area, baseline, Heikin-Ashi, Renko, Line Break, Kagi and Point & Figure where supported.

topics.question: Where does price data come from?
topics.answer: CEX candles and trades use public exchange APIs or WebSockets; DEX pairs and auxiliary metrics use third-party data services. Some requests go directly from your browser, while selected providers use NodeChart serverless proxy routes. Provider limits, delays and outages apply.

topics.question: Does NodeChart store my data?
topics.answer: Workspace state, drawings, scripts, journal entries and Pro proof are stored in browser storage and are not synced to an account. Browser storage is not encrypted and can be edited or cleared. Market and verification requests can reach NodeChart routes or third parties; ad partners may receive connection data.

topics.question: A chart is empty or not updating.
topics.answer: Check the feed status and selected venue. The venue may not provide that pair or interval, or a network/browser extension may block its connection. Try another supported provider or symbol. Availability is not guaranteed by region.

topics.question: How do I change the theme or language?
topics.answer: Use the header controls. Standard themes and the five locales are available there; opening a pre-filled X or Telegram composer unlocks two additional themes on this browser. NodeChart does not verify publication. The initial language may use the browser language when available.

funding.name: Funding rate
funding.body: Periodic payment between long and short sides of a perpetual contract. Positive usually means longs pay shorts; venue conventions apply.

annual.name: Funding annualised
annual.body: Current funding rate extrapolated over a year; a snapshot, not a forecast of future payments.

mark.name: Mark price
mark.body: Venue-calculated reference price used in risk rules. Formula and liquidation use vary by exchange; it does not prevent losses.

premium.name: Premium (mark vs. index)
premium.body: Percentage difference between mark and index prices. It describes a basis, not the cause or direction of a move.

oi.name: Open interest
oi.body: Open contracts reported by the selected venue. A change alone does not identify who opened positions or predict price.

lsrAcc.name: Long/short accounts
lsrAcc.body: Provider-reported ratio of long- to short-oriented accounts. Population and definitions vary; it is not a contrarian rule.

lsrTaker.name: Long/short taker volume
lsrTaker.body: Ratio of reported aggressive buy and sell volume for the selected venue and period. It is not market-wide flow.

lsrTop.name: Top-trader positioning
lsrTop.body: Long/short ratio for a provider-defined top-trader subset. Definitions vary; divergence is not a stand-alone signal.

liq5m.name: Liquidations 5 m
liq5m.body: Reported forced-close volume for the selected venue over five minutes. Coverage may be partial and does not represent the whole market.

nextFunding.name: Next funding
nextFunding.body: Time remaining to the next scheduled funding event; the rate and settlement rules may change.

spread.name: Bid-ask spread
spread.body: Difference between the best visible ask and bid. A snapshot; excludes fees, slippage and execution impact.

imbalance.name: Order-book imbalance
imbalance.body: Relative visible bid/ask quantity in the sampled order book. Orders can change or be cancelled; it is not executed flow.

cvd.name: Cumulative volume delta
cvd.body: Running difference between observed aggressive buys and sells. Coverage and reset window depend on the feed; it is not total-market volume.

delta60.name: Delta last 60 s
delta60.body: Approximate taker buy-minus-sell volume over the recent 60-second window. Descriptive, not predictive.

depth.name: Order-book depth
depth.body: Visible order quantities grouped by price around mid. Snapshot depth can change or be cancelled before execution.

mcap.name: Market capitalisation
mcap.body: Provider-reported total crypto market capitalisation; asset coverage and calculation method depend on the source.

btcD.name: Bitcoin dominance
btcD.body: Bitcoin market-cap share of the provider’s reported total. It measures relative size, not capital flows.

ethD.name: Ethereum dominance
ethD.body: Ethereum market-cap share of the provider’s reported total. It does not identify where capital moved.

fng.name: Fear & Greed index
fng.body: Alternative.me sentiment index on a 0–100 scale using its published inputs. It is not a buy/sell recommendation.

dvol.name: Deribit volume (options)
dvol.body: 24-hour BTC/ETH options volume reported by Deribit. Volume alone does not identify trader intent or position size.

putCall.name: Put/call ratio
putCall.body: Put/call activity ratio for the reported option set. Contract selection and provider definitions matter; it is not a sentiment verdict.

maxPain.name: Max pain
maxPain.body: Modelled strike price that maximizes aggregate option-holder losses at expiry under simplifying assumptions; not a price magnet.

smile.name: IV smile
smile.body: Deribit implied volatility across strikes for a selected expiry. Quotes and coverage vary; skew does not predict direction.

term.name: IV term structure
term.body: Reported implied volatility across available expiries. Term structure describes quotes, not a forecast of realized volatility.

advPct.name: Advancer share
advPct.body: Share of returned USDT pairs with positive 24-hour change in the selected provider dataset. Coverage is not the whole market.

median.name: Median 24h change
median.body: Median 24-hour change among returned pairs. The statistic depends on the provider’s instrument set and filters.

vp.name: Volume profile (VR)
vp.body: Estimated volume by price from loaded OHLCV candles in the visible range; not full trade-level volume or order-book liquidity.

avwap.name: Anchored VWAP
avwap.body: Volume-weighted average from the user-selected anchor over loaded candles. It does not identify holders or institutional positions.

sr.name: Auto support/resistance
sr.body: Pivot zones clustered from loaded candles using configured rules. They are historical levels, not guaranteed support or resistance.

divergence.name: RSI divergences
divergence.body: Compares price and RSI swing points in loaded candles. Divergence can persist and does not confirm a reversal.

session.name: Session stats
session.body: Open, high, low, change, range and annualized volatility for the app’s current session window; descriptive only.

rv.name: Realised volatility
rv.body: Annualized realized volatility calculated from loaded candle returns. It is historical, not a forecast of future volatility.

countdown.name: Candle countdown
countdown.body: Estimated time until the selected interval closes, based on the browser clock and candle timestamps; clock/feed delays may affect it.

patterns.name: Auto chart patterns
patterns.body: Scans visible candles for configured shapes. The displayed score is heuristic, not a probability, confirmation or forecast.

ratings.name: MTF technicals
ratings.body: Rule-based counts from six timeframes, with up to 14 oscillator/average rules when enough candles are available. Cached; not advice.

heatmap.name: Market heatmap
heatmap.body: Heatmap of selected returned USDT pairs: tile area reflects 24-hour volume and colour reflects change. Coverage is provider-limited.

journal.name: Trade journal
journal.body: Local journal summaries are calculated from entries you type (up to 500 saved entries); they are not exchange-verified performance.

magnifier.name: Bar magnifier
magnifier.body: Trade details inside a selected candle when provider history is available. Returned tape may be partial; >$100k tags are thresholds, not identity checks.

replay.name: Bar replay
replay.body: Replays candles already loaded in the chart buffer. Indicators recompute on that slice; missing history is not fetched by replay.

backtest.name: Strategy Lab
backtest.body: Six long-only candle simulations with same-close fills and per-side fees. Excludes slippage, funding, liquidity and real execution.

screener.name: Screener
screener.body: Gate USDT spot rows, periodically refreshed; up to 150 rows are shown. Instrument and endpoint coverage varies.

customScripts.name: Script Lab
customScripts.body: Supported formula language runs in the browser. HTTPS imports require CORS, are limited to 20 KB; up to 50 scripts are saved locally.

scriptTopics.question: How do I write my own script?
scriptTopics.answer: Open Script Lab and enter one formula per candle, for example ema(21) - ema(55). Supported inputs include o, h, l, c and v, plus the functions listed under the editor. Formulas run locally over the current candle buffer; the editor limits formula length and up to 50 scripts are saved in this browser.

scriptTopics.question: How do I import scripts, for example from GitHub?
scriptTopics.answer: Paste an HTTPS URL. GitHub blob and Gist links are rewritten to raw URLs; other hosts must allow browser CORS requests. Imported files are limited to 20 KB. Review the formula before applying it; imports are text for the supported formula engine, not arbitrary JavaScript.

scriptTopics.question: How does a script appear on the chart?
scriptTopics.answer: Applying a formula creates a CUSTOM indicator for the current workspace, either in a pane or over price. Saved scripts remain in this browser and can be edited or deleted; clearing browser storage removes them.

edgeTopics.question: How does Liq Radar work?
edgeTopics.answer: Liq Radar uses up to 400 loaded candles, candle volume/price ranges and 10x, 25x, 50x and 100x leverage assumptions to estimate hypothetical liquidation-price levels. It does not read exchange positions or known liquidation orders. The output is a candle-based model, not a forecast, target or stop.

edgeTopics.question: What does Lag Oracle measure?
edgeTopics.answer: It compares historical candle returns for a selected leader and the chart, then reports sample correlation, beta, lag and hit rate. Notices use a rule-based estimate when a qualifying leader move is detected; they do not predict a follower price or establish causation. The leader feed is loaded while the modal is open.

edgeTopics.question: How does Regime Compass classify market conditions?
edgeTopics.answer: It uses ADX, an ATR-like range ratio against its historical median, EMA21/EMA55 separation, and—when available—funding, market breadth and liquidation-flow metrics. Thresholds assign one of five heuristic labels. The displayed score is not a calibrated probability or forecast; tool buttons only toggle other interface tools.

edgeTopics.question: What does Clock Edge show?
edgeTopics.answer: It groups loaded candle returns by UTC hour and weekday and summarizes the next four-candle return. Cells meet a display gate of at least 30 observations and |t| ≥ 2. Samples overlap, multiple comparisons are not adjusted, and the statistic is descriptive—not evidence of a future edge or forecast.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These notes describe the NodeChart service and its current access model. Please review the limitations before relying on displayed data or tools.

sections.heading: 1. Scope of the service
sections.body: NodeChart is a browser-based charting and market-data interface for selected cryptocurrency markets. It displays third-party data, calculations, estimates and some simulated demo values. Provider coverage and freshness vary.

sections.heading: 2. No financial services
sections.body: NodeChart does not execute trading orders, hold user funds or connect to exchange accounts. Contributions are sent directly to listed public wallet addresses; the Pro flow checks specified public on-chain transactions. Trading takes place on third-party venues under their terms.

sections.heading: 3. Access, advertising and availability
sections.body: Core charting is available without an account or recurring subscription. Third-party ads may appear. Two themes unlock locally when a pre-filled share composer opens; publication is not verified. Selected Pro features require a qualifying, verified on-chain support payment. Features and provider availability may change.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not attempt to disrupt the service or bypass provider protections. Use third-party services and data in accordance with their published terms. Do not present NodeChart as your own product.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
sections.body: The NodeChart name, design and source code are the property of the developer. Third-party data and brand names belong to their respective owners and are used for identification purposes only.

sections.heading: 6. Liability
sections.body: NodeChart provides information and tools without a guarantee of results, accuracy or uninterrupted availability. Digital-asset trading can result in losses. Calculations and signals do not replace independent checks or professional advice.

sections.heading: 7. Updates and contact
sections.body: Questions about these service notes can be sent to the contact address below. Updated text and its date are published on this page.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Review these limitations before using displayed information as part of a trading decision.

sections.heading: No investment advice
sections.body: All content on NodeChart — charts, indicators, numbers, layouts and text — is provided for informational and technical demonstration purposes only. Nothing here constitutes investment, legal, tax or financial advice, and nothing is a recommendation to buy or sell any asset.

sections.heading: No guarantee of accuracy
sections.body: Data is supplied by third parties and may be streamed, polled, cached, delayed, incomplete, sampled differently or unavailable. Some values are calculated estimates, heuristics, simulations or demo data. NodeChart does not guarantee accuracy, completeness or freshness.

sections.heading: Risk of total loss
sections.body: Digital assets can be highly volatile and you may lose some or all of your capital. Leverage and liquidity-pool positions have additional risks; outcomes depend on venue rules and market conditions. Assess risks independently.

sections.heading: No affiliation
sections.body: NodeChart is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any exchange, protocol, foundation or token issuer mentioned in the interface. All trademarks belong to their owners.

sections.heading: Your own responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for checking data and making your own decisions. Verify prices and conditions with the venue you use. NodeChart charts, alerts, ratings, models, backtests and risk calculations are informational tools, not trade instructions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NodeChart does not require registration or provide a user-account profile. The app does make requests to its hosting platform and to third-party data and advertising services; this page describes the main flows without asserting their retention practices.

sections.heading: No user accounts
sections.body: There is no sign-up or login and no NodeChart user-account database. This does not mean that hosting providers, public data services, payment-verification sources or advertising partners receive no request or connection data.

sections.heading: Browser storage
sections.body: Workspace preferences, chart state, drawings, watchlist, scripts, journal entries, support preferences and the Pro transaction proof are stored in browser storage on this device. They are not synced to a NodeChart account service. Browser storage is not encrypted by the app and can be edited or cleared in browser settings.

sections.heading: Advertising and cookies
sections.body: Applicable pages load third-party advertising technology, including Adsterra banner, Social Bar, popunder and sponsored-link scripts. Those services and destinations may receive your IP address, browser headers, referrer or page context and may use cookies or similar storage under their own policies. The locale system may set NEXT_LOCALE; on Cloudflare, the site may set nc_country from the cf-ipcountry request header for region-aware venue selection.

sections.heading: Market, proxy and verification requests
sections.body: Some market-data requests connect directly from your browser to exchanges or data providers; selected requests use NodeChart first-party serverless API routes with allowlisted destinations. Donation verification also sends the selected network and public transaction hash to a NodeChart route for public-chain checks. Providers and hosting services may process request details and connection metadata, including IP address; their own policies apply. The app does not promise that these services retain no logs.

sections.heading: Hosting and logs
sections.body: The deployed site and first-party API routes run on Cloudflare through the OpenNext adapter. Cloudflare receives network requests and may process operational or security logs under its own service terms and configuration. This repository does not provide a NodeChart user-account database or a separately operated persistent application server.

sections.heading: Browser controls and contact
sections.body: You can clear browser storage to remove locally saved workspace data and proof. For questions about information handled by NodeChart-controlled routes, contact the address in the footer. Data handled by exchanges, hosting or advertising providers is also subject to those providers’ policies and request processes.

legal.intro: This page describes the service, its limits and the handling of requests and browser-stored data. It is informational and is not a substitute for advice about your circumstances.

EMA.name: EMA
EMA.hint: Weights recent candles more heavily – trend direction and dynamic support.

SMA.name: SMA
SMA.hint: Arithmetic mean over the period – smooth support and resistance.

BB.name: Bollinger Bands
BB.hint: Middle band is the SMA, outer bands are standard deviations away. A squeeze means low volatility.

RSI.name: RSI
RSI.hint: Momentum between 0 and 100 – above 70 overbought, below 30 oversold.

MACD.name: MACD
MACD.hint: Difference of two EMAs plus the signal line; the histogram shows the strength of the move.

ATR.name: ATR
ATR.hint: Volatility in price points – handy for stop distances.

STOCH.name: Stochastic
STOCH.hint: Compares the close with the trading range of the period.

SUPERTREND.name: Supertrend
SUPERTREND.hint: Trend-following line that flips sides on trend change (ATR × multiplier).

DONCHIAN.name: Donchian Channels
DONCHIAN.hint: Breakout channels: highest high & lowest low of the period.

STOCHRSI.name: Stochastic RSI
STOCHRSI.hint: Stochastic applied to RSI – far more sensitive than RSI alone.

OBV.name: On-Balance Volume
OBV.hint: Cumulates volume on up/down closes – the volume trend.

MFI.name: Money Flow Index
MFI.hint: RSI with volume (0–100): overbought/oversold including money flow.

CCI.name: Commodity Channel Index
CCI.hint: Deviation from the statistical mean price (±100 levels).

ADX.name: ADX / DMI
ADX.hint: ADX = trend strength; +DI/−DI = bullish/bearish directional force.

PSAR.name: Parabolic SAR
PSAR.hint: Dots that trail the price and act as a trailing stop.

TRIX.name: TRIX
TRIX.hint: Rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA – filters noise.

PPO.name: PPO
PPO.hint: MACD in percent – momentum comparable across symbols.

DPO.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
DPO.hint: Price minus shifted SMA – exposes cycles without the trend.

BBPCT.name: Bollinger %B
BBPCT.hint: Where price sits inside the Bollinger bands (0–1).

AROON.name: Aroon
AROON.hint: How recent the period high/low is (0–100; crossovers = turning points).

ICHIMOKU.name: Ichimoku Cloud
ICHIMOKU.hint: Japanese full system: Tenkan, Kijun and the Kumo cloud (Span A/B).

VWAP.name: VWAP
VWAP.hint: Session volume-weighted average price – the institutional benchmark.

WILLR.name: Williams %R
WILLR.hint: Momentum oscillator (−100..0): overbought above −20, oversold below −80.

HMA.name: Hull MA
HMA.hint: Hull Moving Average: near-zero lag with equal smoothing.

TEMA.name: TEMA
TEMA.hint: Triple EMA – almost fully removes EMA lag.

DEMA.name: DEMA
DEMA.hint: Double EMA – halves the EMA lag.

GUPPY.name: Guppy MMA
GUPPY.hint: Six EMAs (3–60): fan spread shows trend strength and regime shifts.

SQUEEZE.name: TTM Squeeze
SQUEEZE.hint: Bollinger inside Keltner = squeeze; momentum histogram shows the release.

TDSEQ.name: TD Sequential
TDSEQ.hint: Tom DeMark setup counts: 9s mark exhaustion points.

CMF.name: Chaikin Money Flow
CMF.hint: Volume-weighted accumulation/distribution pressure over n periods.

EMV.name: Ease of Movement
EMV.hint: How easily price moves: distance divided by the volume box.

UO.name: Ultimate Oscillator
UO.hint: Blends 7/14/28 periods – fewer divergence false signals.

CUSTOM.name: Custom script
CUSTOM.hint: Runs a supported per-candle formula on loaded data in your browser.

edge.liqHow: Liq Radar estimates hypothetical liquidation-price levels from up to 400 candles and 10x/25x/50x/100x leverage assumptions, weighted by volume and recency. It does not observe exchange positions or predict price; these levels are not targets or stops.
edge.liqEmpty: Not enough candles in the feed yet.
edge.lagSub: Historical lead–lag statistics · not a forecast
edge.lagNeed: Loading leader feed – at least 60 candles required.
edge.lagCalm: No qualifying leader move is present in the current calculation.
edge.lagHow: Compares candle returns for the selected chart and leader. Correlation, beta and hit rate describe the available historical sample; notices are model estimates, not forecasts or price targets.
edge.lagPendingText: Historical model estimate after {leader} moved {dir}{bps} bps: {dir}{exp} bps implied by the model; observed move so far {dir}{done} bps. Not a price target.
edge.regimeSub: Heuristic labels from candles and available market metrics
edge.regimeNeed: Not enough candles to classify yet.
edge.rdTrendStrong: ADX and EMA21/EMA55 separation cross configured thresholds. This heuristic label does not forecast continuation.
edge.rdTrendWeak: ADX crosses a configured threshold while EMA separation is smaller; descriptive classification only.
edge.rdRange: Current inputs fall below configured trend thresholds; this does not imply future prices will stay in a range.
edge.rdVolExpand: The ATR-like range ratio is elevated while ADX is below a threshold; this is not a volatility forecast.
edge.rdLiqStorm: Available funding, volatility or liquidation metrics cross configured thresholds; provider coverage varies and this does not confirm forced exits.
edge.clockSub: Historical hour and weekday returns from this candle buffer
edge.clockNowYes: Historical UTC-hour sample ({n} observations): {wr} % of next-four-candle returns were positive; mean {bps} bps. Descriptive statistic, not a forecast.
edge.clockNowNo: The current UTC-hour bucket does not meet the display threshold; this does not establish that no pattern exists.
edge.clockLegend: Cells summarize historical next-four-candle returns by UTC hour and weekday. Colour shows the mean sign; intensity reflects |t|. The display gate is n ≥ 30 and |t| ≥ 2; overlapping samples and multiple comparisons are not adjusted. Not a forecast.

benefit.title: Access, features and limitations
benefit.sub: A clear summary of what is available, how extra options unlock, and where provider limits apply.
benefit.support: Core charting is available without an account or recurring subscription. Ads may appear. Share-triggered themes and verified Pro features use separate unlock flows; provider availability and data freshness vary.

paid.gate: No account or recurring subscription; third-party ads may appear.
Two themes unlock when a pre-filled share composer opens; NodeChart does not verify publication.
Require a qualifying on-chain support payment, verified on supported networks.
Adds a local cosmetic badge and pauses reminders; it does not verify payment or unlock Pro.
Selected CEX/DEX providers; symbols, history, freshness and regional availability vary.
Preferences, drawings, scripts and journal entries stay in browser storage; they are not encrypted or account-synced.

unique: 12 configured CEX identifiers; pair and endpoint coverage varies by venue.
DEX discovery and pool data use third-party services; chain coverage varies.
Alerts run in the open terminal from available feed updates; they are not server-side monitoring.
Backtests, ratings, pattern scores and risk flags are simulations or heuristics, not forecasts or guarantees.
Sponsored links and ads may open third-party destinations with separate content and terms.

marketSignals.title: Market Signals
marketSignals.volumeScope: Ratio = DeFiLlama tracked DEX volume ÷ Binance Spot volume across stablecoin-quoted pairs. This is not total CEX market volume.
marketSignals.trendMethod: EMA 20 vs EMA 50 on each timeframe
marketSignals.dataUnavailable: Live data is unavailable. Try again.
marketSignals.trendUnavailable: Some intervals do not have enough recent candles.
marketSignals.unlockHeading: Unlock Pro with a verified support transaction
marketSignals.unlockDescription: Qualifying one-time on-chain support payment of {amount} or more. Verification is rechecked on reload; access is local to this browser, with no recurring subscription.
marketSignals.verificationPolicy: Direct native ETH on Ethereum Mainnet (12 confirmations), SOL on Solana (finalized), or BTC in a confirmed block. Other chains and tokens are not accepted. Payment must reach a listed NodeChart wallet.
marketSignals.verifiedMessage: Verified payment: {amount}. Pro is enabled in this browser.
marketSignals.belowMinimumMessage: Verified payment is {amount}; the minimum is {minimum}.
marketSignals.localProofNote: The proof and export marker are stored locally. Public transaction hashes can be reused or shared; there is no account entitlement registry. Browser code and storage can be changed, so the local export check is best-effort, not tamper-proof.
marketSignals.walletsTitle: Send at least $5 equivalent to a listed support wallet for verification

verification.not-found: Transaction not found on the selected network.
verification.invalid: The transaction does not match a NodeChart support payment.
verification.unavailable: A public chain or price provider is unavailable.

marketSignals.whaleDescription: Provider-returned trades strictly above $500,000 notional on matching CEX candles, when the feed is available. Buy and sell bubbles use different colors; coverage may be partial.
marketSignals.tvlDescription: A 120-day DeFiLlama protocol-TVL graph appears below supported DEX charts when the token symbol maps unambiguously.
marketSignals.tvlChartHint: This is protocol TVL, not token market cap. Unmatched symbols remain blank.
marketSignals.tvlAmbiguous: Several protocols share this ticker; no potentially incorrect TVL series is selected.
marketSignals.tvlUnmatched: No unambiguous DeFiLlama protocol ticker match was found.
marketSignals.spreadMethod: Most liquid DexScreener pool per chain versus Binance Spot; pool liquidity must be at least $10k. A spread is not an executable arbitrage.
marketSignals.spreadNeedsContract: Choose a DEX token with a contract address to search cross-chain pools.
marketSignals.spreadUnavailable: No liquid matching DEX pool or Binance Spot price is available.
marketSignals.unlockTitle: MCap / FDV proxy · not an unlock calendar
marketSignals.unlockRatioUnavailable: No public pair provides both market cap and FDV; the ratio is left blank.
marketSignals.unlockUnavailable: The public DeFiLlama protocol endpoint provides TVL, not a verified unlock calendar. MCap/FDV is only a rough proxy and is not circulating supply. No unlock dates are shown.
marketSignals.recheckUnavailable: The saved proof could not be checked now. Pro remains unavailable in this browser until a later verification succeeds.
